subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA click identifiers be exposed to agents/plugins and persisted in session metadata, and on which exact surface and retention boundary?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but `ctwaClid` is ad-click tracking metadata, so exposing or retaining it needs an explicit product/security decision before implementation.

options.title: Plugin/session metadata only
options.body: Extract CTWA attribution into a typed WhatsApp metadata object for plugin hooks or session attributes, with retention limits and no prompt exposure by default.

options.title: Prompt-visible context too
options.body: Also render selected CTWA fields into untrusted prompt context so agents can inspect them directly, accepting broader transcript and model-context exposure.

options.title: Keep CTWA IDs hidden
options.body: Leave current behavior unchanged unless maintainers approve a stronger attribution and compliance boundary later.

recommendation.title: Plugin/session metadata only
recommendation.body: Extract CTWA attribution into a typed WhatsApp metadata object for plugin hooks or session attributes, with retention limits and no prompt exposure by default.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans plugin hook mapping and session metadata history where this person introduced the central seams.
